segments.name: Steady Low-Baseload Consumers
segments.description: Consistent low energy footprint with minimal fluctuations. Represents energy-efficient facilities or off-peak baseload operation.
segments.strategy: Install automated low-power standby schedules & smart sub-metering to prevent phantom loads.

segments.name: Heavy Industrial Peak Loaders
segments.description: High total energy consumption driven by intensive machinery, HVAC, or manufacturing operations across all periods.
segments.strategy: Implement peak shaving via Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), HVAC chiller optimization & Siemens Demand Response.

segments.name: Weekend-Heavy Facility Operations
segments.description: Pronounced operational surges on weekends and non-standard hours (e.g. data centers, weekend venues, maintenance shifts).
segments.strategy: Schedule high-load batch operations during low-cost renewable generation hours & off-peak tariff blocks.

segments.name: Diurnal Daytime Commercial Buildings
segments.description: Classic commercial office profile with sharp morning ramp-ups, sustained mid-day consumption, and evening shut-downs.
segments.strategy: Deploy Siemens Desigo CC building management automation, pre-cooling algorithms, and smart occupancy sensors.

segments.name: Volatile / Variable Load Consumers
segments.description: Irregular consumption spikes with high standard deviation, indicative of batch processing, intermittent machinery, or uncalibrated controls.
segments.strategy: Deploy AI-driven predictive load forecasting, fault detection & diagnostics (FDD), and power factor correction.
